svg.title: Chrono-Grid: contribution graph that reforms into a clock and a self-solving cube
svg.desc: TimeLordRaps' GitHub activity graph (468 contributions in the last year) periodically reforms into the time 07:18 PST, with Pong played between PAST and FUTURE inside the digits. The contributions on its right-hand side fold into a Rubik's cube that scrambles and solves itself, then everything melts back into the activity graph.
svg.text: SAT 14 NOV 2026 · SYNC 07:18 PST · SAN DIEGO
